question.text: An electron projected perpendicular to a uniform magnetic field B moves in a circle. If Bohr's quantization is applicable, then the radius of the electronic orbit in the first excited state is :

solution.text:
$m v r=\frac{n h}{2 \pi}$ ...(i)
$r=\frac{v m}{B q}$ ....(ii)
$\begin{aligned} & n=2 \\ & m r\left(\frac{r B q}{m}\right)=\frac{2 h}{2 \pi} \\ & r=\sqrt{\frac{h}{\pi B q}} \\ & q=e \\ & r=\sqrt{\frac{h}{\pi B e}}\end{aligned}$
